title: Analista de Customer Success Manager
description:
Se você gosta de olhar para uma carteira de clientes e enxergar oportunidades de crescimento, essa vaga é para você.

O desafio


Buscamos um Customer Success Manager Pleno para atuar como farmer da base ativa, com foco total em retenção, expansão e aumento de receita.
Aqui, CS não é atendimento — é estratégia, análise e monetização.

Você será o braço do comercial dentro da carteira, trabalhando lado a lado com a operação para transformar resultados em novas oportunidades de negócio.

Se você busca desafios, crescimento e um time que joga junto, vem com a gente

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Analisar a carteira de clientes e identificar oportunidades de upsell, cross-sell e expansão
  • Conectar performance, resultados e necessidades do cliente em ações de crescimento
  • Apoiar a operação com direcionamento estratégico e priorização
  • Atuar em parceria com o time comercial para monetizar a base ativa
  • Antecipar riscos de churn e desbloquear oportunidades de evolução

O perfil que buscamos

  • Perfil farmer, com visão de crescimento e monetização
  • Forte capacidade analítica e leitura de dados
  • Comunicação consultiva, clara e orientada a valor
  • Mentalidade de dono sobre resultados e receita
  • Facilidade para transitar entre operação e comercial

Por que essa vaga é diferente

  • Você não atende cliente operacionalmente
  • Atua com foco direto em crescimento de receita
  • Tem impacto real em retenção, LTV e expansão
  • Trabalha em um ambiente orientado a dados, performance e resultado

Essa vaga é para você se…

  • Gosta de pensar em crescimento antes de pensar em suporte
  • Se sente confortável analisando números e oportunidades
  • Quer atuar em CS com viés comercial e estratégico

O que oferecemos:

  • Os benefícios serão informados pela recrutadora.
  • Acesso aos cursos da Staage.
  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento profissional.
  • Desenvolvimento contínuo e aprendizado constante.
  • Gestão meritocrática.
  • Possibilidade de sociedade baseada no desempenho e alinhamento cultural com o negócio.

title: Chef de Partie  Resort Brazil ou no estrangeiro
description:
Você conhece o Club Med?
Temos quase 70 resorts, abertos no verão e no inverno, em 26 países. Oferecemos férias de alto padrão nas montanhas e à beira-mar. Nossos clientes estão em busca de felicidade e liberdade.

Por que você está lendo esta vaga? Porque quer fazer parte desse diferencial que nos torna especiais. Você tem habilidades humanas e profissionais que são valorizadas.

Oferecemos a oportunidade de se desenvolver e evoluir rapidamente ao integrar nossas equipes brilhantes. Você terá a chance de viajar pelo mundo.

Seu ambiente de trabalho
Cada Resort possui vários restaurantes e bares, tanto temáticos quanto mais intimistas, que servem nossa oferta Premium All Inclusive. De buffets a serviços de pratos, de experiências de cozinha ao vivo a inúmeros eventos festivos, você terá diversas oportunidades para expressar seu know-how e criatividade enquanto se enriquece com todas as nossas particularidades. Nossa oferta refinada se baseia em cinco pilares: criar experiências memoráveis, surpreender com uma diversidade de espaços conceituais de gastronomia, trabalhar pelo bem-estar de todos (incluindo o seu próprio), explorar as emoções e sentidos por meio de encenações, tudo em um ambiente divertido e descontraído.

Suas Tarefas

  • Supervisionar uma equipe de 4 a 6 chefs
  • Gerenciar pedidos e estoques para a seção (pratos quentes, frios, café da manhã)
  • Verificar a montagem, apresentação e reposição de buffets (600 a 1000 refeições por serviço)
  • Oferecer serviço empratado no buffet ou no restaurante bistronômico, personalizando o relacionamento com os clientes
  • Garantir a qualidade dos serviços, o cumprimento das normas de saúde e segurança do Club Med, bem como a manutenção dos bens do resort
  • Unir e motivar sua equipe em torno dos objetivos definidos e apoiá-los em seu desenvolvimento
  • Integrar nossas equipes também é uma oportunidade única de viver e trabalhar com pessoas de todas as origens, nos lugares mais "Instagramáveis" do mundo
  • Você criará uma experiência valiosa para seu currículo, em uma empresa que acompanha e treina você continuamente para ajudá-lo a se tornar a melhor versão de si mesmo

Ao se tornar um G.O Chef de Partie, você poderá usufruir das infraestruturas e atividades oferecidas pelo Club Med. E se quiser, você pode até subir ao palco para mostrar seus talentos

Então, pronto para se juntar a nós? Seu futuro começa aqui...
Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Estágio em Sales
description:
Você gostaria da oportunidade de estagiar em uma empresa Global de Energia e Tecnologia? Você gosta de embarcar em projetos desafiadores?
Venha fazer parte do nosso Programa de Estágio
Previsão de Início: Março 2026.
O nosso Estágio é pensado para permitir que estudantes de Nível Superior tenham a oportunidade de ter experiências práticas de trabalho formando uma base sólida para suas vidas profissionais. Nossos estágios lhe darão percepções de primeira mão sobre os processos, sistemas e práticas que estão alinhados para garantir que as necessidades do cliente sejam atendidas por meio de execução impecável e aplicação de tecnologia de ponta.
Esteja ao lado dos melhores
Nosso Estágio vai te proporcionar a oportunidade de participar em Treinamentos técnicos e de desenvolvimento, reuniões de equipe e participar de projetos para apresentar seus resultados Durante seu estágio, você terá todo suporte da equipe, gestão e um Buddy designado especialmente para suas necessidades, garantindo que você tenha uma experiência de aprendizado valiosa
Como estagiário, você será responsável por:
Receber treinamento e mentoria, que permitirão que você complete suas tarefas e projetos que aperfeiçoarão seu aprendizado e habilidades;
Engajar, conhecer e aprender sobre sua área designada, mas não limitando-se à;
Participar e Entregar projetos internos para entregar resultados aos clientes (internos e externos) e identificar oportunidades de melhorias no negócio e área
Aprender o Sistema Operacional interno (incluindo softwares e aplicativos) que te ajudarão no processo de desenvolver e entregar seus projetos e tarefas diárias
Colaborar e Conectar com diferentes times, estagiários e áreas da Baker Hughes para ter um amplo conhecimento e rede de networking global
Aplicar os conceitos de HSE (Saúde, Segurança e Meio-Ambiente) garantindo e mantendo os procedimentos em todas as situações para um ambiente mais seguro, íntegro e saudável.
Participar e Engajar em grupos de integração para estagiários e outros Hubs de voluntariado, Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão que alavancarão seu networking e desenvolvimentos de habilidades por todo o Globo.
Alimente sua paixão:
Para ter sucesso e ser considerado no nosso estágio, você precisa:
Estar regularmente matriculado em cursos de: Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Química, Petróleo, Elétrica, Naval), Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, e relacionados;
Ter interesse e afinidade em: marketing, habilidades de negociação, contato com clientes, e correlatos
Possuir Inglês de nível Intermediário para Avançado;
Conhecimento em Excel e Power Bi;
Ter disponibilidade para estagiar pelo período de 02 anos, 30h por semana;
Possuir o direito de estagiar legalmente no Brasil;
Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação:
Dentro da Baker Hughes temos diversas áreas de oportunidade para estagiar, então confira abaixo mais detalhes para a área de:
Sales & Commercial
O estagiário da área de Sales & Commercial terá diferentes oportunidades de explorar seus conhecimentos dentro da área que for designado, e você pode conferir abaixo quais são as possíveis áreas de atuação na Baker Hughes:
Vendas: O estagiário de vendas dará suporte em iniciativas comerciais, planejamento de vendas e interação entre diferentes áreas impactadas dentro da linha de produto. Durante o estágio, terá contato direto com lideranças financeiras, comerciais e operacionais da empresa, auxiliando com relatórios, apresentações e discussões estratégicas para a região.
Área Comercial: o estagiário da área comercial irá suportar em atividades do uso estratégico de dados de mercado, cliente e competidores e da construção eficiente de dashboards gerenciais como: Construção de estratégias comerciais ganhadoras para as oportunidades identificadas e prospectadas no mercado, Gerenciamento dos processos e stakeholders envolvidos no processo comercial, Elaboração do orçamento dos projetos e apresentação do business case para a alta gestão regional e global.
Customer Care: O estagiário da CC geralmente contribuirá com a equipe de atendimento ao cliente para fornecer as metas operacionais do dia a dia. Espera-se pensamento apropriado e inteligência aplicada ao lidar com questionamentos de clientes, processos de simplificação ou outras situações, e certamente, o estagiário pode se beneficiar de um histórico de engenharia ou qualificação técnica para apoiar cotações e consultas mais tecnicamente orientadas e pode ser capaz de acessar uma carreira em potencial na equipe de Engenharia de Aplicações Comerciais ou Gestão Comercial com a experiência apropriada.
Market Intelligence & Strategy: O estagiário de Market Intelligence & Strategy apoiará previsões de mercado, análises de concorrência e tendências, explorará novos mercados e produtos e contribuirá para a elaboração de planos estratégicos trabalhando com as equipes de vendas, comercial e de produto. Uma oportunidade única para aprender sobre inteligência de mercado e estratégia, com impacto real no futuro da energia.
Localização:
Confira a localização da vaga no momento da sua candidatura, já que temos diferentes escritórios espalhados entre as cidades do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo e Bahia.
Formas de Trabalho:
Nós sabemos que todos são diferentes e que a maneira de trabalhar e entregar resultados no seu melhor é diferente para cada um. Na Baker Hughes, temos diferentes ambientes de trabalho, que dependem da localização e área de atuação. Caso você não tenha disponibilidade para estagiar presencial ou no modelo híbrido, nos sinalize
Sendo um estágio, os Modelos Presencial e Híbrido são as melhores opções, focando em um desenvolvimento mais amplo, diverso e rodeado de oportunidades para Networking.

description:
Our client is a clinical-stage precision oncology company focused on developing novel targeted therapies to inhibit frontier targets in RAS-addicted cancers. The company's R&D pipeline comprises RAS(ON) Inhibitors designed to suppress diverse oncogenic variants of RAS proteins, and RAS Companion Inhibitors for use in combination treatment strategies. As a new member of the team, you will join other outstanding professionals in a tireless commitment to patients with cancers harboring mutations in the RAS signaling pathway.
The Opportunity:
Syneos Health is seeking two Field Medical Advisors (FMAs) to support clinical trial programs in oncology across Latin America. This recruitment requires one FMA to be a resident of Brazil and one FMA to be a resident of Argentina.
This role will be instrumental in driving the scientific excellence, clinical insight, and medical strategy supporting our oncology pipeline and marketed products. The Medical Advisor ensures scientific integrity and alignment with global and LATAM medical affairs objectives. The position will require close collaboration with cross-functional partners including clinical development, regulatory, commercial, HEOR, market access, and field medical teams.
Responsibilities:
Develop and implement the Medical Affairs strategy and tactical plans for assigned products and therapeutic areas, tailored to the local LATAM market (Argentina or Brazil).
Establish and maintain trusted scientific relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), investigators, and healthcare professionals across LATAM countries (Argentina or Brazil).
Provide medical oversight and scientific input to cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment with regulatory and compliance standards.
Contribute to medical input in promotional and non-promotional materials, internal training, and advisory boards.
Plan and execute national medical meetings, symposia, and congress participation to enhance scientific visibility.
Support investigator-initiated trials and local clinical research activities in collaboration with global and regional teams.
Monitor the competitive and scientific landscape to inform internal strategy and provide actionable medical insights.
Partner with HEOR and market access to develop real-world evidence and outcomes research projects.
Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (local regulations in LATAM)
Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations and CROs, including site selection, Site Initiation Visits, and investigator engagement
Provide scientific review to ensure medical accuracy in materials developed by cross functional teams, including non promotional content and internal scientific training.
Requirements:
Advanced scientific or medical degree (MD, PharmD, or PhD) required; oncology experience strongly preferred.
Minimum 8-10 years of experience in Medical Affairs or related functions in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.
Strong understanding of oncology clinical development, evidence generation, and treatment landscape.
Proven ability to interpret and communicate complex scientific and clinical data effectively.
Experience engaging with healthcare professionals, academic researchers, and medical societies.
Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and presentation skills.
Fluency in Spanish/Portuguese and English (written and spoken).
Ability to work effectively in a matrixed, cross-functional, and multicultural environment.
Willingness to travel nationally and internationally (up to 70%).
Preferred Education, Experience and Skills:
Prior experience supporting oncology product launches or lifecycle management activities.
Strong network within the corresponding country oncology community" (Argentina or Brazil)
Experience leading or supporting investigator-initiated or real-world evidence studies.
Knowledge of the corresponding country healthcare system, reimbursement structures, and compliance requirements (Argentina or Brazil)
Track record in publication planning, congress presentations, and scientific communications.

At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.
Why Syneos Health? Here, the work is challenging, and the pace is exhilarating. By joining one of our commercial teams, you're empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. title: IT Support Technician
description:
IT Support Technician

  • Located in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Full Time Position, Monday - Friday

The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

The IT Support Technician provides basic technical support to the Brazil business unit. This role focuses on assisting with day-to-day IT operations, including troubleshooting hardware and software issues, supporting user access, and maintaining system functionality. The position works under the guidance of senior IT staff and collaborates with local teams to ensure smooth IT operations. The role reports directly to the Director of IT and maintains a functional reporting line to the Operations Manager.

Tasks:

  1. Perform basic troubleshooting with the ability to resolve common hardware and software issues for desktops, laptops, printers, and peripheral devices.
  2. Provide user support by assisting with password resets, account lockouts, and VPN connectivity issues.
  3. Monitor system performance and report issues to senior IT staff and via applicable Remedy Ticket Systems.
  4. Assist with software installations and updates of standard applications under supervision.
  5. Provide inventory & setup by preparing new workstations and ensuring proper configuration.
  6. Maintain records of support requests and resolutions.
  7. Perform simple maintenance tasks like cleaning equipment and checking cables.

Skills:

  • Proficient oral and written communication skills in both Portuguese and English.
  • Basic knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals (IP addresses, Wi-Fi setup).
  • Ability to follow instructions and escalate complex issues.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This role does not include supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment:

This position is based in a professional office setting and involves regular use of standard office equipment, including computers and phones. Additionally, the role may occasionally require interaction with enterprise-grade IT and infrastructure systems such as firewalls, network switches, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), and both copper and fiber optic network cabling under the supervision of Senior IT staff.

Physical Demands:

This is an active, hands-on role that requires the IT Support Technician to spend a significant portion of the day standing and moving. The position may involve short bursts of physically demanding activity, such as lifting and relocating computer equipment or navigating stairs. On occasion, tasks may require working in confined or elevated spaces, including under raised computer room floors or above drop ceilings.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:

This is a full-time role, and as such, the IT Support Technician is eligible to participate in the regional benefits program available to Katalyst employees.

Core working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Additional hours, including occasional night, weekend, and holiday work, may be required to fulfill job responsibilities and support operational needs.

Travel:

Occasional travel may be necessary. Mileage for offsite meetings or errands will be reimbursed at the current regional rate. Travel will mostly be within the Rio De Janeiro area visiting client and 3
rd
 party sites to service our equipment located at those sites.

Required Education and Experience

  • Certificate of Completion of Secondary Education
  • IT-related coursework, professional training, or industry certifications preferred.
  • Experience of up to 2 years in IT support, system administration, or networking (including internships or technical school experience).
  • Working proficiency in English.

Additional Eligibility Qualifications:

None required.

Other Duties:

Please note, this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employer for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Would you thrive in a role where technical depth, collaboration, and systems thinking shape the future of subsea developments?
Would you bring the curiosity, adaptability, and engineering mindset needed to solve complex challenges in early-phase offshore projects?
Join our Subsea & Surface Pressure Systems Team
Bringing cutting-edge physical and digital technologies together to create subsea systems the beating heart of our work. Devising smarter systems that control and monitor oil and gas extraction, our subsea products and flexible pipe capabilities are industry leading. Our team provides support for customer operations to ensure continuity for production.

Partner with the best
As a Subsea Systems Engineer, you will be challenged to lead Front End Engineering & Development studies, where you will give support to projects and support technology development at a system coordination level. You will also support execution of subsea projects. You will be supporting the regional sales and commercial teams, interacting with Customers providing technical expertise during early engagement activities.

As a Subsea Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Executing System design to proposals and projects.
  • Reporting of progress, technical and interface matters in project meetings and progress reports of assigned tasks and CTRs.
  • Defining system layout from concept definition phase to FEED, detail engineering and execution phases of a subsea project.
  • Defining and preparing functional specifications for subsea system building blocks such as Trees, Controls, Wellhead connections, Manifolds, and Flowlines.
  • Acting or supporting the study manager with technical interface, change control, technical variations, and general delivery of the scope.
  • Providing system design input to large subsea project proposals and equipment contracts.
  • Liaising with clients on a technical level to ensure their needs are being met and ensuring they are aware of the data input requirements to allow the study to proceed on-schedule.
  • Supporting the OFE sales and commercial organization in identifying and pursuing opportunities related to early engagement or invitations to tender.
  • Assisting in the preparation of proposals as part of a proposals team or technical peer checker.

Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a MSc or BSc degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Controls Engineering or equivalent as required with extensive experience in a similar role.
  • Have broad knowledge of processes, methods and procedures within project and engineering management.
  • Have proven experience in front-end design activities, covering concept, pre-FEED and FEED studies.
  • Have proven experience in design and selection across one or more of the following: Field architecture / Flow assurance / System Analysis / Interface Management / Requirement Management / Process engineering / Subsea Production Systems / Risers, flowlines and pipelines / Control systems / Constructability and installation.
  • Have demonstrable depth of experience in project engineering within a multi-disciplinary environment.
  • Be available to travel internationally for project needs and for short term assignments.

Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours - from 7am-4pm
  • Location: RETIC, Ilha do Fundão, Rio de Janeiro.

Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

About Us:
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us:
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you Let's come together and take energy forward.

title: Atendente Operador
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:
A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

O projeto Light Recicla atua na de troca de resíduos recicláveis por bônus na fatura de energia elétrica. Tal iniciativa considera a educação ambiental, por meio da reciclagem, como elemento fundamentador da construção de uma sociedade com maior responsabilidade social e ambiental.

title: Engenheiro (a) de Reservatório Sr
description:
Somos a Brava Energia, a Companhia independente de óleo e gás mais diversificada do Brasil.
Temos operações em terra e mar, do upstream ao downstream, com mais de mil colaboradores em nossa força de trabalho. Oferecemos amplas oportunidades para o desenvolvimento da sua carreira, em um ambiente dinâmico, focado em resultados e alta performance. Estamos constantemente aplicando a experiência do nosso time para maximizar nossa produção, transformando O&G em valor para o Brasil.
Venha crescer com a gente
Missão do cargo:
Conduzir o desenvolvimento e a implementação de estratégias avançadas para otimizar a recuperação de óleo e gás, assegurando a eficiência no desenvolvimento de reservatórios e fornecendo suporte técnico especializado para projetos de alta complexidade e novas oportunidades.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Aplicar métodos de previsão de comportamento de produção, incluindo DCA (Declination Curve Analysis), Balanço de Materiais e elaboração de poços tipo, focando na precisão de diagnósticos e previsões.
Construir modelos de simulação numérica, ajuste de histórico e elaboração de cenários de previsão de produção buscando otimizar o desenvolvimento dos campos Onshore.
Conduzir estudos de revitalização de campos maduros, com foco em métodos de recuperação secundária e terciária (Waterflooding e/ou Steamflooding), liderar propostas de novos poços, oportunidades de workover e integrar equipes multidisciplinares (Geologia, Geofísica e Operações).
Preparar estimativa, avaliação e classificação de recursos e reservas, aplicando as normas da PRMS.
Liderar a elaboração e revisão de entregáveis regulatórios, garantindo o alinhamento técnico e o cumprimento de prazos do BAR (Boletim Anual de Reservas), PAT (Plano Anual de Trabalho), PAP(Plano Anual de Produção) e PD (Plano de Desenvolvimento), além de representar a companhia em demandas técnicas junto à agência.
Atuar como mentor técnico, sendo responsável pela formação de novos talentos na área de reservatórios.
Liderar a avaliação técnica de novos ativos (New Ventures), construindo cenários probabilísticos robustos que fundamentem avaliações econômicas e decisões de investimento (CAPEX/OPEX).
Requisitos e qualificações
Superior completo em Engenharia de Petróleo ou áreas correlatas.
Inglês Avançado.
Experiência em Gestão de Campos Maduros e estratégias em soluções de problemas para garantir a maximização dos volumes, reservas e taxas de produção; análise de decisão e risco para quantificar incertezas de engenharia.
Conhecimentos sólidos em políticas definidas pela PGN, órgãos públicos ou requeridos nos sistemas de Qualidade, Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança para a indústria de óleo e gás.
Conhecimento em terciária(Polímeros/Surfactantes/MEOR) será um diferencial.

title: Projetista Estrutural Sênior
description:
A RMO é uma empresa de engenharia, consultoria marítima, vistoria e inspeção que valoriza a excelência técnica, a inovação e a flexibilidade no trabalho. Atuamos com um time dinâmico e comprometido em entregar soluções técnicas de alto desempenho para projetos navais e offshore. Estamos em busca de um Projetista Estrutural Sênior que compartilhe nossa visão e contribua ativamente para nossos projetos desafiadores. A posição é para atuação no Rio de Janeiro, em regime de tempo integral, com contrato permanente.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Desenvolver projetos estruturais detalhados e de alto nível técnico para aplicações navais e offshore, com foco em fabricação, montagem e instalação;
  • Elaborar, revisar e detalhar desenhos de fabricação (DF), desenhos de montagem (DM), planos estruturais e documentação técnica associada;
  • Realizar modelagem 3D e detalhamento de estruturas metálicas e equipamentos complexos, garantindo compatibilidade com os processos de fabricação.
  • Criar e manter desenhos técnicos utilizando softwares CAD (AutoCAD, SpaceClaim, Rhinoceros 3D, entre outros), assegurando conformidade com normas e especificações técnicas aplicáveis
  • Definir e detalhar materiais, componentes e métodos construtivos, garantindo atendimento aos requisitos estruturais, operacionais e de segurança do projeto;
  • Assegurar que todos os projetos estejam em conformidade com normas técnicas e regulamentações vigentes (ABNT, NBR, ISO, bem como normas e práticas da indústria naval e offshore);
  • Aplicar procedimentos internos, padrões de clientes e boas práticas de engenharia ao longo de todo o ciclo do projeto;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico às equipes de engenharia, fabricação, montagem e operações durante todas as fases do projeto;
  • Realizar levantamentos e delineamentos em campo, coletando dados necessários para o desenvolvimento e ajuste dos projetos;
  • Revisar e atualizar projetos conforme necessário, incorporando alterações solicitadas por engenheiros, clientes ou decorrentes de ajustes em campo;
  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto aos clientes e às equipes internas, promovendo comunicação clara, proativa e eficaz ao longo do projeto;
  • Colaborar com as áreas de engenharia naval, estrutural e mecânica, garantindo integração e compatibilidade entre disciplinas;
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e de coordenação, contribuindo com soluções construtivas e melhorias no desenvolvimento dos projetos;
  • Controlar, organizar e manter atualizada a documentação técnica dos projetos, assegurando rastreabilidade e controle de revisões;
  • Executar todas as atividades em conformidade com os processos internos de Qualidade, Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (QSMS);
  • Contribuir para soluções construtivas que otimizem prazo, custo e segurança operacional;
  • Identificar e resolver, de forma proativa, eventuais problemas técnicos durante a execução dos projetos, adotando uma abordagem prática e orientada à solução.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação técnica ou tecnológica em Desenho Técnico, Mecânica, Estruturas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em projetos estruturais aplicados à construção, modificação e reparo de estruturas navais e offshore;
  • Disponibilidade para acompanhamento de atividades em campo (porto, fábrica, estaleiro e offshore) e para realização de viagens, conforme a necessidade do projeto.
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e orientado à identificação e solução de problemas técnicos;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de projetos, bem como dos requisitos de Qualidade, Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (QSMS);
  • Fluência em português e conhecimento básico de inglês para comunicação oral e escrita em contexto técnico.

Qualificações Diferenciais

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência na elaboração de desenhos estruturais aplicados à fabricação de estruturas metálicas, bem como à modificação e ao reparo de estruturas navais e offshore;
  • Experiência com normas aplicáveis ao setor de projetos de engenharia Naval e offshore (API, DNV, ABS, etc.) e regulamentos brasileiros aplicáveis ao setor offshore.

Benefícios e Diferenciais da RMO

  • Regime de trabalho flexível com possibilidade de "home office";
  • Ambiente colaborativo e foco no desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Participação em projetos de destaque no setor naval e offshore.

Processo Seletivo:

  • Análise Curricular, com foco na experiência em projetos navais e offshore;
  • Entrevista Técnica, avaliando a vivência prática em estruturas offshore e navais;
  • Avaliação Técnica Específica, voltada à comprovação de conhecimento em desenhos estruturais, incluindo leitura, detalhamento e solução de problemas construtivos;
  • Entrevista Comportamental, para avaliação de competências interpessoais e aderência ao ambiente industrial e offshore.

title: vendedor autosservico i
description:
O Grupo 3corações é construído por pessoas, antes de tudo, apaixonadas pelo que fazem. Temos orgulho de crescer pela força do trabalho e seguir, cada vez mais longe, sem esquecer a nossa essência e os nossos valores. É pelo nosso jeito simples de ser que celebramos a diversidade de pessoas e as experiências saborosas que entrelaçam histórias. O resultado é uma companhia com produtos de qualidade, colaboradores e consumidores felizes, fornecedores e parceiros integrados em uma mesma missão proporcionar experiências prazerosas que promovam alegria e bem-estar, criando laços duradouros e gerando valor para todos. Deguste um mundo de possibilidades na maior empresa de cafés do Brasil

Saiba mais em

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Garantir a cobertura e volume sadio em todos os pontos de vendas cadastrados da área que atende, cumprindo o plano diário de visitas;
  • Garantir a execução dos serviços oferecidos aos clientes, por meio de contatos com as demais áreas da empresa;
  • Explorar oportunidades de negócios de acordo com canal e mix ideal, identificando soluções por meio de realização de visitas diárias, cadastrando novos clientes e introduzindo novas linhas de produtos;
  • Acompanhar e garantir o plano conjunto de ação (JBP), juntamente ao cliente;
  • Acompanhar clientes que estão inadimplentes, garantindo a venda continua e saudável;
  • Garantir atualização dos relatórios de estoque de mercadorias dos clientes com as informações colhidas nos pontos de vendas;
  • Avaliar validade dos produtos, qualidade da comunicação visual, padrão de qualidade dos produtos servidos, de modo a garantir a melhor experiência para o consumidor;
  • Manter-se atualizado de informações comerciais corporativas e de orientações de mercado através da participação em reuniões com a equipe mensalmente;
  • Avaliar exposição dos produtos e ambientação do PDV, com os materiais de merchandising, promovendo a venda;
  • Levantar oportunidades sobre as novidades do mercado observando ações da concorrência;
  • Criar relacionamentos legítimos e duradouros com clientes, consumidores e comunidade, fazendo-se reconhecer como consultor especialista nos nossos produtos e equipamentos, capaz de oferecer soluções.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em administração, marketing ou áreas afins.

Necessário

  • Kit de Produtos mensal;

  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Wellhub.

O Grupo 3corações é uma empresa de gente apaixonada pelo que faz. Crescemos pela força do nosso trabalho, valorizando nossas origens e nossa essência para irmos cada vez mais longe. Somos um povo inovador e empreendedor, que cuida dos colaboradores e proporciona experiências prazerosas para todos com quem nos relacionamos.

Nossa história começou em 1959, no interior do Rio Grande do Norte. Com nosso jeito de ser, inovador e empreendedor, nos tornamos líder nacional no segmento de café torrado e moído e cappuccino e vice-líder em café solúvel. Em 2013, lançamos a solução de máquinas multibebidas TRES, com mais de 30 sabores de bebidas em cápsulas, e, em 2020, a partir da joint venture com a Positive Company, entramos para o mercado plant based, oferecendo aos nossos consumidores produtos 100% naturais, de origem vegetal. Também integram o nosso portfólio itens como café solúvel, cappuccino pronto para beber, achocolatado, café com leite, refrescos, derivados de milho, filtros para café e porta-filtros.

Somos mais de 8 mil corações apaixonados pelo que fazem, empenhados em construir um país e um mundo melhores. Respeitamos e damos valor a todas as pessoas e culturas e acreditamos que a diversidade enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho. Buscamos pessoas que querem arregaçar as mangas e trabalhar de forma colaborativa.

Venha para 3corações e junte seu coração aos nossos

Temos quase 70 resorts, abertos no verão e no inverno, em 26 países. Oferecemos férias de alto nível nas montanhas e à beira-mar. Nossos clientes estão em busca de felicidade e liberdade.

title: Marketing Program Manager
description:
About Cambly
Cambly is transforming how the world learns English. With millions of students across the globe and thousands of native English-speaking tutors, we've created a platform where real conversations lead to real fluency. We're not just another language app—we're building authentic human connections that break down barriers and open up opportunities.
As we expand, we're scaling our creative capabilities to match our global ambitions. This is where you come in.
About The Role
We're looking for a strategic, creative builder who can establish Cambly's voice in organic channels from the ground up—someone who sees the white space and knows how to own it. If you thrive on 0-to-1 challenges, love the intersection of content and growth, and want your work to directly impact millions of learners worldwide, this role is for you.
You'll own our SEO/AEO strategy and community presence, establishing sustainable channels that reduce our reliance on paid advertising while building trust and authority with professional English learners in Japan, Korea, and globally. This is a high-impact role where you'll create new programs, coordinate cross-functional teams, and directly influence Cambly's long-term growth trajectory.
Note: this is a remote position for candidate who is based in Brazil but outside Rio.
Responsibilities
Develop and execute Cambly's SEO/AEO program to increase organic search visibility and ranking for high-intent keywords across markets in APAC, LATAM, and Europe, including localized blog strategy, influencer partnerships for backlinks, and technical SEO implementation in partnership with the Product team.
Develop global social media strategy with localized content approaches for different markets and platforms, including Instagram optimization and YouTube expansion plans.
Outline measurable goals and create monthly reports on how we are tracking against them.
Create content strategy centered on social proof: user testimonials, tutor spotlights, student success stories, and product education that drives conversion and builds community trust.
Build community management frameworks for global platforms (including Naver - Korea, among others), local review sites, and global social channels with culturally relevant messaging.
Manage SEO content agencies and coordinate with creative teams (designers, video editors, copywriters) to produce high-quality, on-brand content at scale.
Track, analyze, and report on SEO, social, and community performance metrics to measure impact, inform strategy iterations, and present insights to leadership.
Partner with Growth, Product, and Marketing teams to align content strategy with business goals while monitoring competitive landscape and platform trends in target markets.
Requirements (Must-Haves)
5+ years of experience in SEO, content strategy, or digital marketing with proven track record of building and scaling organic channels
Demonstrated expertise in SEO/AEO strategy, including technical SEO, content optimization, and link-building programs
Strong understanding of social media platforms, algorithms, and content strategies across multiple channels (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, etc.)
Experience developing and executing content strategies that drive measurable business results (traffic, engagement, conversion)
Experience managing agencies, freelancers, or content teams to produce high-quality work at scale
Proficiency with analytics tools (Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar) and ability to translate data into actionable insights
Excellent project management skills with ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously
Native in Portugese and excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Nice to Have
Familiarity with international or APAC markets, particularly Japan and Korea
Familiarity with AI tools for content optimization and SEO research
Experience in language learning, education technology, or subscription businesses
Knowledge of video content strategy for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok
Background managing influencer content programs or creator partnerships

title: Customer Success Onboarding Specialist
description:
Customer Success Onboarding Specialist

In-office in Rio de Janeiro

>>> Only resumes in english <<<

About the Project

A leading content creation & marketing platform for K-12 athletic departments, schools, and districts in the U.S., trusted by thousands of customers across all 50 states. One of the key products is interactive touchscreen displays that showcase a school's awards, records, and history.

About the Role

As a Launch Specialist, you will be the first to welcome a newly signed school or athletic department to Touch and guide them through a smooth, high-quality launch. You'll manage multiple customer accounts at different onboarding stages, collect required assets, confirm setup details, and build much of the initial Touch site yourself (pages, content, layouts) to ensure the display is accurate, visually polished, and ready for launch—then support a seamless handoff to Customer Success.

Requirements

  • Ability to effectively manage multiple customer accounts, each at different stages of the onboarding journey;

  • Growth mindset: you're a lifelong learner who's committed to continuous professional growth and development;

  • Solutions-oriented with a strong sense of ownership; you can identify issues and take appropriate action;

  • Hunger for a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve, change is standard, and flexibility is a must;

  • Strong design sense with the ability to create clean, organized, and visually polished Touch sites;

  • Excellent English fluency, including reading, writing, and verbal communication (C1/C2 proficiency preferred);

  • Prior experience in a customer-facing role (1+ year) is a plus;

  • Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours and be in-office five days per week.

Responsibilities

  • Welcome newly signed schools or athletic departments to Touch and guide customers through a smooth, high-quality launch;

  • Manage a portfolio of partners in different stages of the onboarding journey; collect required assets and confirm setup details;

  • Build much of the initial Touch site: structuring pages, organizing content, configuring layouts, and ensuring accuracy and completeness;

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to resolve questions, remove blockers, and keep launches moving forward on schedule;

  • Manage a high volume of inbound and outbound emails, Zoom meetings, and calls; answer questions and set timelines;

  • Log all activity in Salesforce and ensure a seamless handoff to the Customer Success team after a successful launch.

We offer

  • Mentorship and career growth: Learn directly from experienced B2B SaaS leaders, with a clear path for professional development across a variety of roles in support, sales, and customer success;

  • Ownership and impact: Take responsibility for real outcomes and see your work make a difference for thousands of organizations;

  • Startup experience: Gain hands-on exposure to how a fast-growing SaaS company operates;

  • International opportunity: Work from Brazil, with a global team, selling into the U.S. market;

  • Time off includes ~13 standard, annual US holidays, 15 business days of PTO for the first year, 18 for year two, and 21 for every year after;

  • In-office in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (five days per week).

title: Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Company You'll Join


At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid. 

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they've managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners. 

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft. 

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F. 

The Problems You'll Solve 


As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on-boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on-boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client's limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on-boarding process
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post-sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on-boarding experience for customers

The Impact You'll Have


You'll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund's back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders. 

About You


From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem-solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world-class on-boarding experience. 

  • Proven success in a project management capacity
  • Ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Experience working with financial data and information
  • Great people skills – high degree of empathy and great communication skills
  • Experience working with clients
  • Experience in implementing and successfully managing small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements
  • Interested in working with enterprise software

title: HR Administration Officer
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. description:
Descrição da vaga

Quer mover a sua carreira na Motiva?
A Motiva é o lugar certo para o seu talento, na qual você pode escolher o caminho que deseja seguir juntamente com uma empresa que promove a melhoria da qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da mobilidade. Nos comprometemos em construir uma cultura cada vez mais diversa e valorizamos a inclusão de todas as pessoas independente de cor, etnia, religião, idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo e com equidade de oportunidades.

  • Elaboração e implementação de programas de segurança;

Habilidade em liderança, comunicação efetiva, proatividade e resolução de problemas;

Capacidade de antecipar riscos e implementar soluções preventivas;

CNH categoria B;

Conhecimento em Pacote Office, auditoria interna e normas regulamentadoras.

Informações adicionais

Ao entrar para o nosso time integrado, você fará parte de uma empresa presente em
13 estados
do país e que movimenta milhares de pessoas diariamente ao oferecer mobilidade de forma íntegra e que gera impacto positivo na sociedade. Aqui, você encontrará diversos benefícios para apoiar o seu desenvolvimento e dar mais movimento para a sua carreira.

Assistência Médica-Hospitalar;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida;

Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

Política de flexibilidade na jornada de trabalho, e muito mais

Quer melhorar a vida das pessoas através da mobilidade e contribuir para chegarmos ainda mais longe? Então, traga o seu talento para a Motiva.
SOBRE A MOTIVA

A Motiva é feita de pessoas interessadas em contribuir para o nosso propósito: melhorar a vida das pessoas através da mobilidade.
Somos referência em infraestrutura de mobilidade no Brasil, liderando o setor com foco na criação de valor sustentável e melhorando a vida das pessoas através da mobilidade. Atuamos em serviços de infraestrutura para mobilidade, focados nos segmentos de concessão de rodovias, trilhos e aeroportos.

São mais de 16 mil colaboradores responsáveis pela gestão e manutenção de 4.475km de rodovias, por onde circulam cerca de 2 milhões de veículos, diariamente. Nos trilhos, administramos serviços de transporte de passageiros de metrôs, trens e VLT, transportando diariamente, 3 milhões de passageiros. E no segmento de aeroportos, com 20 terminais sob nossa gestão, atendemos mais de 40 milhões de clientes anualmente.

Para que os clientes possam chegar em segurança nos seus destinos, a Motiva investe em práticas que reforçam o compromisso com o meio ambiente, com o social e com a governança, construindo infraestrutura, implementando serviços e oferecendo oportunidades.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Requisition Number: 19657
Contract Type: Permanent
Location(s):
Rio de Janeiro, BR,
(Senior) Network Engineer
Role Description Summary
When defining the purpose of a job it is helpful to consider questions like:
In what way does it contribute to the value of company?
What part of the organisation's or team's total purpose is accomplished by people in this job?
What is the unique contribution of this job that distinguishes it from other jobs?
Primary Responsibilities / Key Result Areas
As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be a valuable team member on our Enterprise Network Operations team supporting SES's Corporate and Commercial Aviation Networks and Security infrastructure. This individual will be part of a team responsible for the implementation and troubleshooting of SES's growing network and datacenter presence around the world. You will lead and assist with various projects that will challenge your skills with routing, switching, security, VoIP, and multi-media services including inflight entertainment. This position will work with and manage vendor relations and could have a voice in the purchase/quote process, as our business continues to expand. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, possesses deep troubleshooting skills, and understands the delicate balance between network uptime and security compliance.
Troubleshoot and resolve network issues involving Intelsat switches, routers, circuits, etc.
Troubleshoot issues with our Palo Alto and Juniper firewall platform as well as implement policy rule changes to facilitate new services and connectivity.
Document changes to all SES infrastructure to include Visio diagrams, spreadsheets, and cloud-based tracking and documentation software.
Collaborate with Network Engineering on the implementation, buildout, decommissioning, and refresh of SES teleports, datacenters, and sales offices.
Coordinate with system design and network operations for existing data expansion, consolidation, and relocation.
Manage vendor relationships to get their equipment specs, list prices and other vendor information.
Collaborate with Network Engineering on the development of floor plan layouts for datacenters and corporate offices.
Develop equipment purchase orders, track orders, and arrange implementation with remote hands if not traveling for datacenter and corporate office related equipment.
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
5-7 years' hands-on experience working in large complex network / datacenter environments specifically managing Cisco, Palo Alto, Juniper and F5 hardware.
Strong command of Cisco IOS, IOS-XE, and NX-OS, PAN-OS, JUNOS, F5 and Linux command-line interfaces.
Advanced knowledge of Switching technologies to include, Spanning Tree (RPVST+, MST), LACP, VLANs, and Trunking.
Proficient with routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, RIPv2, MPLS, HSRP, VRRP, GLBP, SD-WAN)
Working knowledge of F5 load balancing to include monitoring and troubleshooting load balancing VIPs, pools, and health monitors to minimize downtime and ensure seamless failover across multi-data center environments
Working knowledge of Linux Operating system to include monitoring, automation of operational tasks, and troubleshooting Linux parameters, file systems, and network stacks to maximize performance for high-throughput applications.
Working knowledge with dual homing service providers and ISP redundancy
Extensive experience working with Cisco hardware including switches, routers, ASRs, ASA, FWSM, IPS, load balancers, Nexus
Hands-on troubleshooting skills to include Wireshark packet capture debugging and analysis.
In depth knowledge of security protocols, TACACS, RADIUS, different flavors of VPN and remote access.
Experience with Telco services, T1, DS3, SONET, OC3 – 192.
Datacenter design, redundancy and failover experience a plus
Racking various types of networks and server equipment.
Documentation skills for datacenter, corporate office, and remote sales offices.
Cage cable management experience.
Advanced troubleshooting skills of datacenter and office network environments.
Other Key Requirements / Comments
CCNP Enterprise (Cisco Certified Network Professional) OR equivalent
PCNSA (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator)

title: Senior Completion and Intervention Engineer
description:
This position is for a Well Completion Engineer, responsible for designing and planning well completions, coordinating interventions, and supporting execution activities to ensure safe and efficient well operations from preparation to final closeout.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by the Subsurface team.
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly budgets and well/project specific AFE's.
  • Forecast and be accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific long lead requirements.
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination and quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel.
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required.
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required, including conducting service quality meetings.
  • Ensure vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process to ensure timely action/close out.
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required.
  • Contribute to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS).
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, execution and closeout activities.
  • Ensure compliance with company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied materials, equipment and services, including review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required.
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process.
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings.
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and third-party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance.
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations.

Well/Project Specific Duties:

  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team, including optimizing well planning, design, engineering, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities. Activities include performing offset reviews and well hazard identification.
  • Establish subsurface well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material and equipment selection.
  • Identify special engineering studies to be performed.
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required.
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and present a succinct recommendation.
  • Raise requisitions and purchase orders.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services, including review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Review all applicable operating, installing and testing procedures, including interface documents.
  • Assist with drilling-related engineering, mobilisation, installation and commissioning activities if/when required.
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP/IWOP's as part of well/project commencement.
  • Ensure the Well Barrier Schematic is current and valid for the current operation being performed.
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties.
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices.
  • Review the engineering-focused After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt.
  • Responsible for compilation of End of Well Reports (EOWRs).
Requirements

Education:

  • Degree in Engineering 
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) - Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant Well Completion and Well Intervention engineering experience.
  • At least 5 years experience with operators in Brazil including IOCs.
  • Project experience on dry tree development(s) including exposure to conceptual and detailed design as well as execution of completions and well intervention operations.
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution.
  •  Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) – Wellplan, WellCAT, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages.
  •  Knowledge of Brazilian well integrity regulations SGIP/SGSO.
  • Familiarity with well testing and well clean-up activities is desirable.
  • Experience with subsea completion and intervention considered an advantage

title: Regulatory Senior Analyst
description:
The Regulatory Senior Analyst will be responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance for offshore operations and projects, defining deliverable scopes and deadlines, and supporting engineering, sustainability, safety, project management, and operations teams. This position will coordinate regulatory requirements, consolidate technical documentation, assess compliance risks, support audits and inspections, and implement action plans to address findings. The role contributes directly to maintaining operational licenses, preventing non‑compliance, avoiding fines or interdictions and ensuring alignment with internal schedules, budgets and applicable Brazilian authorities' requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Define the scope and deadlines for deliverables that sustain compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, observing production schedules and budgets.
  • Support the definition of responsibilities and resources to achieve regulatory compliance efficiently, observing the BWE organization charts and budgets.
  • Incorporate lessons learned to BWE, set action plans to prevent or address audit findings, notifications, and conditions to operate imposed by the Authorities.
  • Collaborate with engineering, sustainability, safety, project management, and operations to ensure awareness of regulatory requirements, build compliance, and fulfill BWE schedules.
  • Ensure that compliance-related tasks are executed efficiently, facilitating licenses and approvals, as well as preventing fines and interdictions.
  • Consolidate engineering document lists, including all tech safety studies that are required to grant and sustain licenses and approvals needed to operate.

title: Production Operator
description:
The Production Operator will be responsible for safely operating and monitoring the facility's process and utility systems to ensure stable and efficient offshore production. This includes operating separation, compression, dehydration, seawater injection and utility systems, preparing equipment for maintenance, performing process analyses, supporting emergency response actions, and ensuring compliance with operational and safety procedures. The role contributes to maintaining safe operations, equipment integrity, and consistent production performance.

Responsibilities

  • Start/stop and operate oil and produced gas separation plants, gas compressors, glycol dehydration, HPU systems, produced water systems and utilities.
  • Understand the safe operating limits of these systems and parameter control.
  • Start / stop and operate water cooling, coarse / fine filtration, deaeration and seawater injection systems. Understand the safe operating limits of these systems.
  • Philosophy of isolations, Permit to Work, Operational, Fire and Gas, and COSHH Task Evaluation. Basic knowledge of cause and effect.
  • Knowledge of the actions and duties of emergency event response as required in abnormal / emergency situations.
  • Knowledge and understanding of actions required to minimize commercial loss while maintaining safe operation. Prepare / isolate equipment or systems for intrusive maintenance.
  • Responsible for conservation and preservation as well as first line maintenance on production system (valves and equipment).
  • Assist and stand-by when Electrical / Instrumentation and mechanical technicians are working on process systems in order to keep the system safe to perform work.
  • Perform oil and gas pipeline cleaning activities using pigging technology.
  • Communicate effectively with co-workers and communicate any deficiencies to the Control Room Operator and Production Supervisor. Control, operate and optimize daily chemical dosing rates associated with the process system.
  • General organization and maintenance duties in work area.
  • Perform dew point analysis, TOG analysis, BSW analysis, pH analysis
  • Perform external readings according to the frequency defined by the PSUPT, verify the values with the Control Room Operator and report any deviations found to the supervisor, defining corrective measures.
  • To generate clear and simple reports aligned with the task.
  • Other duties that are related to the function, as instructed, and requested by the Production Supervisor Maintain up-to-date certification applied to his/her function and medical certificates Participate in company training, as defined.
  • Ensure compliance with BW procedures as applied to your position, including the work permit system. Comply with all emergency tasks assigned to your role in the emergency response plan, when applicable.
  • Required to be fully familiar with and comply with the Company, Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental Policies and Procedures assigned to your title / position.
  • Anticipate and realize any unsafe condition and ensure that the correct actions are taken as per procedure. Responsible for your own safety and for the safety of your co-workers.
Requirements

Education

  • Technical or equivalent qualification from the country of origin.

Experience

  • Experience in offshore production operations or similar environments.

Knowledge

  • Knowledge aligned with the company's Competence Assurance Assessment requirements.
  • Familiarity with production systems, utilities, chemical dosing, pigging operations, and laboratory/process analyses (dew point, TOG, BSW, pH).
  • Understanding of isolation philosophy, Permit to Work procedures, Fire & Gas principles, emergency response actions, and operational safety requirements.

title: Intern- Rio
description:
Description

ABS Interns are integrated into ABS business operations and will experience various aspects of engineering review, technical problem solving, and/or research and development. Interns will work with a designated advisor to learn and develop skills relating to ABS's core business functions while also assisting ABS with key deliverables. It is expected that interns will be assigned multiple projects for their respective departments throughout the course of their internship. Interns will work at the local ABS Consulting Office. 

What You Will Do:

  • The primary function of an intern is to develop skills and knowledge of ABS core business functions including but not limited to:
    • Engineering Plan Review.
    • Technical Plan Review.
    • Research and Product Development.
    • Operational Safety and Evaluation.
    • Data Science and Digital Services
  • Interns may provide engineering support in the form of design review and analysis assignments typically involving a major project or several smaller, less complex projects. Projects will vary in complexity and difficulty.
  • Under the supervision of an experienced engineer or engineering manager, interns may assist with a detailed engineering review of plans as assigned for compliance with applicable Rules, Regulations, and contract commitments.
  • Communicate the status of the current workload to all appropriate members of the team to ensure that the needs of the clients will be met.
  • May propose technical advice to field operations and other technical offices.
  • May propose new approaches to problems encountered and make recommendations for changes in methods, procedures, or designs.
  • May assist in the development of business performance metrics including the development and implementation of an ongoing business performance monitoring program, and the periodic analysis of operating results to determine causes, trends, etc.
  • May assist with the writing and presentation of technical papers and reports concerning areas of expertise and work performed.
  • May assist with Rule development projects as assigned.
  • Interns may collaborate with the digital team and with other departments such as services, class, project management, commercial operations, etc.
  • Intern may assist with data collection efforts for data quality improvement, in both existing and new data streams to support overall business goals.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in progress in Chemical Engineering (other related Engineering degrees – e.g., Mechanical, Production, Safety, Process – may be considered).
  • Currently enrolled from the 6th semester (or equivalent) onwards.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong interest in risk analysis, process safety and process engineering, especially in sectors such as marine/offshore, oil & gas and mining.
  • Availability to work 30 hours per week (e.g., 6 hours per day, Monday to Friday), during business hours.
  • Intermediate knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) – especially Excel for data treatment and KPI/risk indicator analysis.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English (and Portuguese).
  • Organization, attention to detail and interest in quality, risk and safety from a systems and process perspective.
  • Analytical mindset and genuine interest in working with data, engineering information and risk scenarios.
  • Proactivity and curiosity to understand client processes, technologies and risk scenarios in marine/offshore, oil & gas, mining and other industrial sectors.
  • Attention to detail and rigor in technical documentation, records and analyses.
  • Teamwork and collaboration, with ability to interact with multidisciplinary technical teams (engineering, operations, safety, quality, etc.).
  • Good organizational skills to manage multiple analytical tasks and deadlines.
  • Ethical behavior, focus on safety and alignment with ABS values of integrity and responsibility.

It would be nice if you had: 

  • Academic or extracurricular experience related to process safety, risk assessment, reliability, process simulation or industrial operations.
  • Basic understanding of risk analysis methods (e.g., HAZID, HAZOP, Bow-tie, LOPA, FMEA) and/or management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO – even if only from university courses.
  • Familiarity with process flowcharts, PFDs, P&IDs and basic process engineering concepts (mass/energy balance, unit operations, etc.).
  • Experience with spreadsheets and basic data analysis (advanced Excel, simple dashboards, basic BI tools) is a plus.

Reporting Relationships:

You'll work alongside engineer colleagues reporting into a Senior Manager. colleguages 

Important: This internship does not involve laboratory activities. It is a position focused on theoretical and analytical work, risk and process evaluation, data analysis and technical documentation.

title: Oficial de Eletricista I
description:
Executar serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva de INSTALAÇÕES, inspecionando sistemas elétricos, efetuando a troca de lâmpadas, luminárias e reatores, verificando o estado de interruptores, tomadas e condutores, passando cabos por conduletes, instalando eletrocalhas, eletrodutos e dutos subterrâneos e realizando outras tarefas, visando o atendimento às necessidades do Contrato. Executar a manutenção elétrica preventiva e corretiva de MÁQUINAS E EQUIPAMENTOS (Aparelhos e equipamentos hospitalares, Back Lights, Postes de Iluminação, Boilers, Bombas hidráulicas, Tele Tubos, máquinas de lavar louça, cafeteiras, liquidificadores, fornos, etc. ), lubrificando peças e trocando circuitos, comandos e motores, a fim de possibilitar o pleno funcionamento da infra-estrutura do Contrato. Executar a manutenção preventiva de QUADROS ELÉTRICOS de BAIXA Tensão, isolando ferramentas, reapertando e trocando disjuntores e borneiras de circuitos, instalando contactores, verificando condições de fios e cabos, efetuando medições de tensão e corrente elétrica através de aparelho Multiteste, limpando componentes com a utilização de produtos químicos específicos e realizando outras atividades, visando o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos, instalações e infra-estrutura do Contrato. Realizar operações em LINHAS DE ALTA TENSÃO no caso de queda de energia e mediante autorização da Light, efetuando manobras e transferências de ramais de acordo com os equipamentos e procedimentos de segurança requeridos, a fim de possibilitar a religação da força necessária ao atendimento das necessidades do Contrato. Executar a manutenção preventiva de NO BREAK, efetuando a leitura de parâmetros e a medição de corrente elétrica, reapertando peças, limpando componentes e trocando baterias, a fim de manter as condições de operacionalidade requeridas. Executar a manutenção preventiva de SUBESTAÇÕES, limpando componentes, reapertando e lubrificando peças, medindo a voltagem de baterias, trocando fusíveis, verificando o funcionamento de quadro de capacitores, nível de óleo combustível e lubrificante de motores e estado de conservação de correias e mangueiras, bem como, inspecionando ruídos, aquecimentos e outras anormalidades, a fim de propiciar o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos e infra-estrutura do Contrato. Operar Subestações no caso de falta de energia elétrica, acompanhando a ligação automática do equipamento e desligando o Gerador no restabelecimento da força, visando o pleno fornecimento de energia para máquinas e instalações do Contrato. Efetuar a manutenção preventiva de TRANSFORMADORES, reapertando e lubrificando peças. Efetuar a leitura de plantas, desenhos e diagramas elétricos. Emitir formulário específico (Laudo), detalhando tipos de problemas, setores, equipamentos e outras informações referentes aos serviços executados, para fins de controle e informação à Chefia. Efetuar anotações em Livro de Ocorrências, indicando os eventos ocorridos, serviços executados, horários, datas e outras informações pertinentes, a fim de possibilitar o controle dos serviços de manutenção. Atuar em outras especialidades de manutenção elétrica conforme a necessidade. Orientar os demais profissionais da equipe, dirimindo dúvidas e indicando procedimentos, a fim de agilizar os trabalhos de manutenção.
